name: resume-to-excel
description: Upload a resume in any format, extract candidate data with Groq AI, and export to Excel.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
